title: Write a custom AutoCloseable session

blocks.text: Any class that implements `AutoCloseable` can be declared in a try-with-resources statement, and its `close()` is called automatically when the block exits.

items: `Session(String name, List<String> log)` opens a session that records what happens in `log`;
`void use(String what)` adds `"use " + what` to the log;
`void close()` adds `"close " + name` to the log (it throws no checked exception);
`boolean isClosed()` says whether **this** session has been closed (each session keeps its own state, even when two share a name and a log).

blocks.text: Page's pitfall: a resource is closed after its try block, so using it there must fail with `IllegalStateException("Resource is already closed")`. And a resource may be closed more than once by careless callers.

cases.says: A session declared in try-with-resources is used, then closed as the block ends.
The session is closed even when the block throws.
Using the session after the try block, once it is closed, throws IllegalStateException("Resource is already closed").
A second close() does nothing: the session is closed only once.

concepts: A resource declared in try-with-resources is closed automatically when the try block exits, normally or by an exception.
A resource is closed once its try block ends, so using it afterwards fails.
Any class of your own becomes a resource by implementing AutoCloseable and its close() method.
